summary: Define expiring execution leases and safe ticket takeover

delivery.outcome: Define a time-bounded execution lease with a ten-minute takeover grace period, conditional renewal and fencing-safe takeover for ticket worktrees.
nonGoals: No automatic merge, branch deletion or credential handling
No takeover based only on process presence, idle time or a dirty checkout
No runtime daemon in the standard repository

architecture.decision: Make ticket-lifecycle the semantic owner of an execution lease. A lease is active for 3600 seconds, reclaimable only after a further 600-second grace period, and every renewal or takeover uses compare-and-swap generation plus fencing. git-lifecycle will consume this contract for worktree write fencing in a separate adapter change.
dataChanges: Lease records carry expiry, takeoverAt, generation and fencing values
architecture.rollback: Revert the new lease contract and guidance; existing ticket lifecycle remains valid.
